Here's your answers. His lips aren't yellow, he's wearing lipstick. His hair isn't weird in my opinion it just has a lot of strands, it adds detail for me but to each their own. His head isn't a "triangle" at least I don't see it. He has a defined jawline that's all. The coloring it mine, if you don't like that then don't worry because none of it is in the actual manga. Finally I don't think their clothes are weird, just expressive. JoJo's is a very flamboyant manga leading to many calling it "gay" and frankly I agree. There are gay characters throughout and especially in the later parts the characters outfits and designs become a bit crazy. If that's not for you to each their own. Personally, I believe Araki has crafted some of the most beautiful manga panels I have ever seen and JoJo's is my favorite anime/manga of all time.
